sample_conditions.surface_area_method: Ar adsorption at -196 degC and BET equation as printed; pore diameter via mercury pycnometry
sample_conditions.wet_preparation: Mortars mixed with ~40 wt% water and dried at 110 degC under N2; extrudes ~32 wt% initial humidity, dried at 110 degC overnight. These preparation water fractions are not reaction RH.

normalization_audit.source_bulk_inventory_information: Eq1 uses W0, initial active CH mass fraction, sample height and Xmax; Eq5 uses W0, sample bulk volume and CH molar density. Definitions are available but individual raw weights/volumes/purity are not numerically tabulated.
missing_for_surface_flux_to_brick_volume: target brick m_CH/V_bulk including binder dilution and current CH inventory
same-phase reactive/wetted fraction of BET area and its conversion/coverage evolution
local CO2/RH at reactive surface, not simply inlet or external chamber values
specimen specific initial mass, initial active CH mass fraction, exposed geometry and pressure
transport separation for diffusion-controlled shaped specimens
normalization_audit.admissible_use: Source-specific conversion/RH/time observations and diffusion-front constraints; not a uniform brick reaction coefficient.
normalization_audit.exclude_as_P37_L: Fitted tortuosity/front advancement is a transport closure. BET contrast and Xmax are capacity/passivation observations, not a direct 1/s affinity-law coefficient.

sample_conditions.material: commercial powdered Sigma-Aldrich Ca(OH)2; portlandite-only subset reviewed for kinetic use
sample_conditions.conditioning: N2 desiccator over saturated CaCl2 (~30% RH) for at least 14 days

missing_for_surface_flux_to_brick_volume: target brick phase mass loading and bulk volume
actual powder bed height, bulk density and porosity (container depth is not a measured filled height)
total chamber pressure and local reactive-surface gas boundary
active wetted fraction and product-layer accessibility of BET surface
particle size/distribution, individual CH purity and repeat/error covariance
normalization_audit.admissible_use: Time-resolved CH consumption and humidity-history/passivation constraints for this source powder; report approximate/censored endpoints and mass bases explicitly.
normalization_audit.exclude_as_P37_L: A humidity-switch sample is not a fresh 91%-RH specimen; 8.2 g CH/100 g dry weight is not 8.2% of initial CH and is not converted without its mass denominator.
normalization_audit.product_identity_limit: At 57% RH products include aragonite, calcite and early amorphous carbonate. At 91% RH calcite predominates. Total CaCO3/CH consumption cannot silently mean calcite-only production in the host.

normalization_audit.water_domain_note: 15 vol% gas water in Fig3 is a gas composition at high temperature, not 15% RH. No RH computed without water saturation-pressure and total-pressure inputs.

manual_reading_contract.conversion_reading_precision: +/-0.02 for RH95/80/60; +/-0.01 for RH0; analyst conservative reading bands, not statistical or author experimental error
manual_reading_contract.curve_points: Manual primary-figure readouts. They are not author raw observations, independent repeats or exact rates. No smoothing, clipping, time shifting or fitting.
manual_reading_contract.dry_limit_discrepancy: Prose plateau <=.05 retained alongside approx figure readings .052/.057 with +/- .01 reading precision. No values changed to match prose.

canonical_unit_contract.specific_area: m2/kg of an explicitly identified mass basis (reported source BET is per CH-containing powder, not automatically per active CH)
canonical_unit_contract.mass_loading: kg of the identical area mass basis/(m3 target brick)
canonical_unit_contract.partial_pressure: Pa; computed only with explicit source total pressure; all real-source values remain null
canonical_unit_contract.surface_to_volume: qV = j * S_basis * (m_basis/V_bulk) * f_reactive; area_mass_basis and loading_mass_basis must be explicit and identical; f_reactive has no default and needs phase allocation/wetness/coverage/accessibility evidence. With true phase-specific S_CH the basis can be active_CH; reported impure-powder BET is not automatically S_CH.
canonical_unit_contract.conversion_interval: average extent rate = n_CH_initial * deltaX/delta_t; divide by actual sample bulk volume for qV; not P37 L
canonical_unit_contract.source_Eq5: epsilon_CH = 1 - W0/[V_sample*rho_CH*M_CH]; source rho is molar density in kmol/m3 and M in kg/kmol
canonical_unit_contract.mass_gain_water_ledger: Net solid mass gain per extent is M_CO2 - f_released*M_H2O. Eq1 implies f_released=1; retained/adsorbed water requires explicit independent corrections.

P37_mapping_limit: Forward P37 uses r=L*n_CH_current*(p_CO2/P_ref)*(1-exp(delta_mu/RT)). Observed initial-inventory conversion rates do not supply current-inventory L, interfacial affinity, local gas activity, effective area or transport separation. No L is calculated, fitted, assigned or admitted.
